hints.title: Group by Bike
hints.text: Aggregate over bike_number to isolate each individual bike.

hints.title: Latest Timestamp
hints.text: Compute the maximum end_time for each bike to retrieve the latest usage moment.

hints.title: Descending Order
hints.text: Sort the results by end_time in descending order.

hints.title: Latest Usage Query Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    bike_number,
    MAX(end_time) AS end_time
FROM Bikes
GROUP BY bike_number
ORDER BY end_time DESC;
```

complexity.time: O(N log N) sorting bike usage by timestamp
complexity.notes: Group-by bike aggregation computing maximum timestamp.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries scan the table once per bike.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups by bike_number and selects MAX(end_time) cleanly.
